Admissible run types give two explicit transfer matrices whose determinants were expanded independently and checked against exhaustive labelled graph tests. The cycle trace identity gives coefficient formulas; simple uniquely smallest positive denominator zeros, proven using gcd-one support, give exact exponential coefficients. D_B-D_A=z^3(1-z^2-z^5)>0 at the first positive D_A root, forcing the two distinct radii. The external standalone verifier replays all 2^n labelled subsets for each n=5..16; this is supplementary to the all-n proof.

value.rationale: General existence is known, but exact labelled counts by each LD-side size and the fraction of stronger simultaneous-LD partitions are natural nontrivial quantitative gaps. A four-state transfer yields all two-sided coefficients, while a strict dominant-root inequality proves that the stronger property becomes exponentially atypical. This qualitative growth separation is neither the previously catalogued one-sided sequence nor a routine substitution in an existence theorem.
